title: Value types: why number 30 differs from text “30”
goal: Distinguish a number from text containing the same digits, obtain a separate number and check which inputs fit the task.

prerequisites.text: You have assigned variables and displayed a sum in your own training infobase. Saving source, updating the infobase configuration and starting a new session are familiar steps.

sections.title: The task: same digits, different meanings
paragraphs: A request card shows 30. The value might be a numeric duration or text made of two characters. A message alone can make them look alike. We will inspect the type, perform an explicit conversion and trace what remains in the original variable.

You will then receive two durations as strings and add them as numbers yourself. A known zero, a negative input and text containing a unit will reveal the boundary between conversion and the task’s rule.

sections.title: The value behind a name
paragraphs: A value’s type determines the meaning of operations. In Минуты = 30; the right side is a number. In ТекстМинут = "30"; it is a string: quotation marks delimit the text, which contains the characters 3 and 0. Variable names help a person read the code; the assigned value determines the current type.

ТипЗнч, called TypeOf in English, returns the type of the current value. Calling it does not change Минуты. A later assignment can put a different type into a BSL variable: after Минуты = "30"; it contains a string. The name “minutes” alone cannot establish its type.

sections.title: Obtain a number and preserve text
paragraphs: Число, called Number in English, reads a suitable numeric representation and returns a number. ПреобразованныеМинуты = Число(ТекстМинут); assigns that result to a separate variable. The original ТекстМинут still contains the string "30".

ПреобразованныеМинуты + 15 combines two numbers and produces 45. Combining the strings "30" + "15" instead joins their characters into "3015". The explicit conversion makes the intended operation visible in the source.

flow.caption: A string produces a separate number
alternative: Number reads that string and returns a new numeric value.
The new number 30 is assigned to ПреобразованныеМинуты; ТекстМинут remains a string.
Adding the number 15 to the new number gives 45.

sections.title: One display, different values
paragraphs: Read from top to bottom. The first two messages show types; the last shows numeric addition. The verified Russian 1C client displays the type names Число (Number) and Строка (String). Selecting an English lesson does not change the installed client’s language. The source deliberately stays identical in both lesson editions.

tables.caption: Trace each statement
rows: Digits in a string are still text.

sections.title: Make your prediction first
paragraphs: Change only ТекстМинут = "30"; to ТекстМинут = "20";. Минуты in the first line remains 30. Predict all three messages. Why can the last change while Минуты stays the same?
Write your prediction before opening the explanation.

reveal.title: Compare your prediction with the trace
paragraphs: The messages are Число, Строка, 35. The last statement uses ПреобразованныеМинуты obtained from ТекстМинут. It does not use Минуты, so the unchanged first 30 does not participate in this sum.
After conversion, ТипЗнч(ТекстМинут) still returns Строка. Add this observation to your copy if you want to inspect it directly; the conversion does not rewrite the source string.

sections.title: Change only the source text
paragraphs: Run the changed version in the same training infobase. Save the source, update the infobase configuration and start a new session. The messages must come from that source version; an old message is not the result of the new calculation.

sections.title: Known zero, empty text and an unset value
paragraphs: The number 0 is a known duration: for example, no time was required. The empty string "" has a String type and contains no characters. Неопределено (Undefined) is a separate value for an unset value in the relevant context. Replacing all three states with zero loses the reason why data is missing.

ЗначениеЗаполнено (ValueIsFilled) checks technical fill state. Its answer for zero does not choose a valid-duration rule for us. Our exercise allows a known duration of zero minutes; missing and invalid inputs need a separate decision.

tables.caption: Three different states
rows: It can be added to another number.
Clarify the input instead of silently assigning a duration.
Preserve its distinction from a known zero.

sections.title: Observe a known zero
paragraphs: With numeric zero, the messages show Число and 15. This is a separate observable case. It makes no promise about converting empty text.

sections.title: Conversion boundary and the duration rule
paragraphs: The string "-1" has a valid numeric representation. Число("-1") returns −1. Our duration, however, must be nonnegative. Conversion only obtains a number; a range check must implement the task’s rule. We will express that check as a condition in the next lesson.

The text "18 минут" (“18 minutes”) lies outside the integer-text format used here. In the verified training 1C, Число("18 минут") raised “Преобразование значения к типу Число не может быть выполнено” (the value cannot be converted to Number). An ordinary handler without exception handling will not reach the later sum message.

This lesson does not implement a general parser for arbitrary human input. Units, empty strings and alternative separators need an agreed format and a failure policy. Replacing a conversion error with 0 would present an unknown input as a known quantity.

sections.title: Why Null returns with queries
paragraphs: Null occurs, for example, when a query result has no corresponding value. It is another meaning of missing data, distinct from a known duration of 0. This calculation does not introduce or test Null. We will revisit it with table joins, where its cause becomes concrete.

sections.title: Where to execute your program
paragraphs: Use the application module of your own separate training infobase. In the verified Russian Designer 8.3.27.2214, the root menu command is Открыть модуль приложения (Open application module). The module contains ПриНачалеРаботыСистемы. Expand the plus beside the procedure header if its body is folded.

Keep the previous source separately. Use one startup handler in your training copy and change its body. Practice provides a complete scaffold; do not add a second procedure with the same name. Save with Ctrl+S, update the infobase configuration with F7 and start a new session with F5.

figures.alt: Real Designer: the training configuration root menu offers Открыть модуль приложения (Open application module). This opens the familiar startup-handler context.

sections.title: Now handle two original strings
paragraphs: The independent task represents inspection as "18" and repair as "7". Obtain two separate numbers, add them and display the sum. Then display both original variables’ types: their string values must remain available.

Predict the result when the first string is "0", then "-1". Explain separately why the program can produce 6 although a negative duration violates our rule. The next lesson will automate rejection; record the current limitation accurately.

sections.title: When the observation differs
paragraphs: If you get 187, inspect whether you added the original strings or the two Number results. If the sum is correct but an original variable became a number, find the assignment back into that variable. Check the sum and preservation of source data separately.

A conversion-line error does not mean the language cannot use strings. Compare the actual input representation with the agreed format. Repeat the same case after a correction and preserve the observed result, rather than only the absence of a diagnostic.

sections.title: Compare both the value and the types
paragraphs: Practice lists the expected observations for the independent cases. The screenshot shows the reference running in installed 1C; your draft and execution remain your own separate work.

selfcheck.prompt: Only ТекстМинут changes from "30" to "20" in the main example. What is the last message?
selfcheck.feedback: The current string “20” is converted;20+15=35. The separate Минуты variable is not used in this sum.
Quotes denote text; similar display does not make it numeric.

selfcheck.prompt: What does Число(ТекстМинут) do when its result is assigned elsewhere?
options: Permanently changes the original variable’s type
Returns a number while the original text remains a string
selfcheck.feedback: Conversion returns a value; assigning it elsewhere leaves the source string intact.

selfcheck.prompt: Why should unknown duration not silently become zero?
options: That loses the distinction between known zero and missing/invalid input
selfcheck.feedback: The domain defines whether zero is valid; absence and error are different states.

selfcheck.prompt: The independent task’s first string becomes "18 минут". What does the earlier successful 25 for "18" establish?
options: Only the earlier numeric-text case; text containing a unit requires a separate check.
All text is automatically stripped of units.
Any conversion error always means zero minutes.
selfcheck.feedback: A successful prior case does not expand the input contract. The shown code raises a conversion error for “18 минут”.

selfcheck.prompt: Use your trace to explain the original strings’ values and types after conversion. Why does "-1" convert but fail the valid-duration rule? What is lost if every invalid input is replaced with zero?
selfcheck.feedback: This free response is not automatically graded. Compare source strings, separate numbers, business range and the distinction between error and known zero.

practice.title: Two text durations: calculate and preserve the source values
practice.task: Inspection is the string "18" and repair is the string "7". Create a separate numeric variable for each, calculate their sum and display it. Display the two original strings’ types in the next two messages. Then test the first string "0", "-1" and "18 минут". Record the actual calculation separately from the valid-duration decision.
practice.environment: Official installed training 1C:Enterprise 8.3; your separate infobase; application module and ПриНачалеРаботыСистемы handler. The Nexus editor stores an optional draft; 1C executes BSL.
practice.externalRoute: Your training infobase → Designer → application module

paragraphs: ТекстОсмотра and ТекстРемонта remain strings. Each Number result is assigned to a different variable, so the source values remain available for explanation and diagnosis.
For "18" and "7", the messages are 25, Строка, Строка. For "0" and "7", they are 7, Строка, Строка. Adding the source strings directly would give 187.

For "-1" and "7", this short source produces 6. It does not yet validate the business range, so the negative input is not accepted as a duration. For "18 минут", conversion fails before the sum message. Conditional validation and failure handling are the next learning steps.

cases.label: Numeric conversion succeeds; range rule fails
cases.output:
6
Строка
Строка
Input −1 violates the nonnegative-duration rule. This version does not reject it automatically.

cases.label: Text containing a unit
cases.output: Conversion to Number fails. The sum and subsequent type messages are not produced.

criteria: Preserve both source strings and assign each conversion to a separate variable.
Obtain the three expected messages for ordinary and zero inputs, rather than concatenated text.
Distinguish a convertible negative number from a valid duration; do not count 6 as successful admission of a negative duration.
Preserve the real error for text containing a unit; do not invent a fallback result 0.
Keep a prediction, your source, actual observations and an explanation. Self-report alone cannot prove an external run.
practice.hint: Convert each string with Number and assign the results to different variables. Sum those numbers and apply TypeOf to the two original strings.

steps.title: Predict the observations
steps.where: Your training infobase and prediction in Nexus
steps.action: Write the three expected messages for 18/7 and 0/7 before running. Classify −1 and text containing a unit separately.
steps.why: A prior prediction exposes adjusting an answer to an observed message.

steps.title: Open your training copy
steps.where: Your training infobase and prediction in Nexus
steps.action: Keep your previous source. Open the application module from the configuration root and use a single existing startup handler.
steps.why: Your own copy and previous source let you compare changes.
steps.expected: You know the infobase name and folder; previous work is preserved.

steps.title: Write your calculation
steps.where: Your training infobase and prediction in Nexus
steps.action: Use your own starter. Obtain two numbers in separate variables, display the sum and display the original strings’ types.
steps.why: Different names make preservation of source text explicit.
steps.expected: Your complete handler is ready without a duplicate procedure.

steps.title: Run the current version
steps.where: Your training infobase and prediction in Nexus
steps.action: Save with Ctrl+S. Close your own user session, update with F7 and run a new session with F5. Compare all three messages with your prediction.
steps.why: This checks the applied version rather than saved text or an old session.
steps.expected: The first run displays 25, Строка, Строка.

steps.title: Check boundaries and preserve observations
steps.where: Your training infobase and prediction in Nexus
steps.action: Repeat for 0, −1 and “18 минут”. Record actual output or error and the rule decision; preserve your source.
steps.why: Separate cases reveal replaced types, concatenated strings and missing range validation.
steps.expected: Zero produces 7; negative input calculates 6 but is invalid as a duration; text with a unit raises a conversion error.
